author: Budapest Open Access Initiative
title: Budapest Open Access Initiative: original declaration
claim: Defines open access to scholarly literature, proposes self-archiving and open-access journals, and distinguishes free reader access from the costs of producing and disseminating scholarship.
limit: A declaration, not legislation, evidence of this proposal's effectiveness, or a blanket license for all research materials.

author: Open Knowledge Foundation
title: Open Definition 2.1
claim: Defines open knowledge through public-domain status or open permissions, access, machine readability and open formats; open-license requirements include non-discrimination and no royalty condition.
limit: A definition and interoperability standard, not authority to release personal data, waive community obligations, or override third-party rights.

author: UNESCO
title: Recommendation on Open Science
claim: Adopted 23 November 2021; frames open science across knowledge creation, evaluation and communication, including infrastructure and societal engagement, while recognizing justified restrictions for privacy, confidentiality and sacred or secret Indigenous knowledge.
limit: A recommendation to Member States, not a universal license, directly applicable authorization, or proof that every research output should be public.

author: UNESCO
title: Recommendation on Open Educational Resources (OER)
claim: Adopted 25 November 2019; defines OER as public-domain or openly licensed learning, teaching and research materials permitting no-cost access and reuse, and promotes inclusive and equitable access and sustainable support.
limit: A recommendation, not authority over student records, an exemption from children's rights, or evidence of learning gains from this proposed pilot.

author: Committee to Protect Journalists
title: Digital safety kit
claim: Provides primary journalist-safety guidance on risk assessment, source and communication protection, accounts, devices, and reviewing third-party services' handling of sensitive information.
limit: Practical safety guidance, not a guarantee of source confidentiality, legal privilege, or approval of the proposed journalism collective.
